articles.title: Oil Prices Extend Rally After Ship Attacks and US-Iran Talks Collapse
articles.excerpt: Brent crude heads for a sixth straight day of gains as attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and a breakdown in ceasefire talks keep energy markets on edge.
articles.nri_angle: Rising oil prices affect global energy costs, fuel inflation and portfolio implications for investors worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chandrasekaran Resigns as Tata Sons Chairman After Six-Month Feud With Noel Tata
articles.excerpt: The departure triggers a selloff across Tata Group stocks, with TCS down 5.1%, as the 158-year-old conglomerate faces its latest leadership crisis.
articles.image_caption: Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran, who joined the group as an intern in 1987 and rose to lead its holding company. His resignation follows a six-month standoff with Tata Trusts over his reappointment.
articles.nri_angle: The leadership upheaval at India's largest conglomerate directly affects global investors with exposure to TCS and Tata Motors, two of the most widely held Indian ADRs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Russian Oil Imports Hit Record 2.8 Million Barrels Per Day in July
articles.excerpt: Indian refiners purchased a record volume of Russian crude in July for the second straight month, even as the U.S. sanctions waiver expired and the Trump administration weighed tariffs of up to 100% on major Russian oil buyers.
articles.image_caption: India imported a record 2.8 million barrels per day of Russian crude in July 2026, making up 55.5% of the country's total oil imports. Smaller Indian ports have driven the surge as refineries continue processing Russian crude for export.
articles.nri_angle: India's record Russian oil imports carry direct implications for global energy prices and US-India trade relations, with the Trump administration threatening tariffs that could affect Indian refiners and the broader diaspora economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Intel Raises $20 Billion in Upsized Share Sale to Fund AI Expansion
articles.excerpt: The chipmaker issued 210.5 million shares at $95 each after investor demand topped $100 billion, marking its first stock offering since going public in 1971.
articles.image_caption: Intel upsized its share offering to $20 billion, pricing 210.5 million shares at $95 each. Investor demand exceeded $100 billion as the chipmaker races to fund its foundry expansion.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Turn Buyers in Indian IT Stocks for First Time in 2026
articles.excerpt: FPIs invested ₹3,358 crore in the sector during July as better-than-expected earnings eased AI disruption fears, part of a broader ₹20,200 crore inflow that snapped a four-month selling streak.
articles.image_caption: Foreign portfolio investors invested ₹3,358 crore in Indian IT stocks during July 2026, their first net purchase in the sector this year. The broader FPI inflow into Indian equities reached ₹20,200 crore, snapping a four-month selling streak.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors and tech professionals track FPI flows as a key indicator for Indian market health and IT sector valuations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jefferies Drops HDFC Bank, Adds MCX and Lenskart in India Portfolio Overhaul
articles.excerpt: Christopher Wood's latest GREED & fear note reshapes Jefferies' India long-only portfolio, citing accelerating credit growth and strengthening macro tailwinds as reasons for a more constructive outlook on Indian equities.
articles.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India. Jefferies has removed HDFC Bank from its India portfolio, adding commodity exchange MCX and eyewear firm Lenskart in a strategy overhaul.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking India allocations in global portfolios should note Jefferies' shift from banking heavyweights toward domestic consumption and financial infrastructure plays.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Berkshire Earnings Beat Forecasts as Abel Accelerates Buybacks to $4.5 Billion
articles.excerpt: Operating profit rose 16% to $12.98 billion in the conglomerate's second quarter under CEO Greg Abel, while share repurchases surged nearly 20-fold from Q1.
articles.image_caption: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel speaks at the company's annual shareholders meeting in Omaha. The conglomerate reported second-quarter operating earnings of $12.98 billion, a 16% increase from a year earlier.
articles.nri_angle: Berkshire's renewed capital deployment and portfolio shifts may interest diaspora investors tracking major US conglomerates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: PPFAS Fund Chief Rajeev Thakkar Defends Strategy as Cash Drops to Lowest in Two Years
articles.excerpt: India's largest actively managed equity fund has deployed its once-record cash pile into beaten-down IT stocks and private banks, with its CIO arguing that AI pessimism around the outsourcing sector is overblown.
articles.nri_angle: PPFAS is one of the most popular mutual funds among NRI investors, and Thakkar's views on IT stocks directly affect the sector that employs millions across the Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Meta Cuts 8,000 Jobs in 4 AM Email Blitz as Zuckerberg Admits Mistakes in AI Pivot
articles.excerpt: The largest layoff round since Meta s 2022-2023 restructuring arrives alongside a 145 billion dollar AI spending plan, employee monitoring backlash, and a CEO acknowledging the company has stumbled in execution.
articles.nri_angle: Meta s restructuring affects Indian-American employees in Silicon Valley and raises questions about AI s impact on tech employment for diaspora workers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Senate Advances Bill Threatening 100% Tariffs on India, China Over Russian Oil
articles.excerpt: The bipartisan legislation, named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, passed a key vote 86-12 and would authorize sweeping sanctions on Russia alongside tariff authority targeting major buyers of Russian energy.
articles.image_caption: The U.S. Capitol building in Washington, D.C. A bipartisan Senate panel has advanced legislation threatening 100% tariffs on nations importing Russian oil, including India and China.
articles.nri_angle: The bill could significantly impact India-US trade relations and raise costs for Indian exports to the US, directly affecting businesses and workers in both countries.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Exports Surge 15% in Q1 FY27 as FTA Network Pays Off
articles.excerpt: Shipments to ASEAN and Africa led the growth, with engineering goods, gems, and electronics all posting double-digit gains as India pushes toward a $1 trillion export target.
articles.nri_angle: India's expanding FTA network and export surge create new trade and investment opportunities for NRI entrepreneurs and businesses with cross-border supply chains.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: What Happens to India's Economy If Gen Z Stops Buying Homes
articles.excerpt: With 27% of Gen Z Indians leaning toward renting and housing affordability at a crossroads, a generational shift in homebuying patterns could ripple through banking, construction, and GDP growth.
articles.image_caption: stevehicks via flickr (BY)
articles.nri_angle: India's Gen Z housing shift could reshape the real estate market that many NRI families invest in for rental income or retirement plans back home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Berkshire Hathaway Q2 Earnings Preview: Buybacks, Taylor Morrison, and the Abel Era's Report Card
articles.excerpt: Berkshire is expected to report Saturday, with focus on up to $11 billion in share buybacks, Greg Abel's first major acquisition, and a $10 billion Alphabet bet.
articles.nri_angle: Berkshire Hathaway remains a core holding for many Indian-American investors, and the Abel transition is closely watched across diaspora investment communities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed's Internal Divide on Rate Hikes Deepens as Five Years of High Inflation Tests Patience
articles.excerpt: Three FOMC members dissented in favor of raising rates at the July meeting, the widest split under Chairman Warsh, as 30-year Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on inflation fears.
articles.image_caption: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh at a press conference following the July FOMC meeting. The committee voted 9-3 to hold rates steady as three members dissented in favor of a quarter-point hike.
articles.nri_angle: The Fed's rate trajectory directly affects mortgage rates, auto loans, and borrowing costs for U.S.-based Indian professionals, while also influencing global capital flows into Indian markets and the rupee's stability.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Excludes Loans Against Fresh NRI Deposits From Priority Sector Lending Targets
articles.excerpt: The central bank's latest move removes a key regulatory friction for banks lending against FCNR(B) and NRE deposits, building on a series of measures that have attracted over $32 billion in NRI inflows since June.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai. The central bank has excluded loans against fresh FCNR(B) and NRE deposits from priority sector lending calculations as part of its ongoing push to attract NRI capital.
articles.nri_angle: NRI depositors benefit from the most favorable deposit environment in over a decade, with uncapped interest rates, CRR/SLR exemptions, and PSL exclusion creating strong incentives to park capital in FCNR(B) and NRE accounts.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Forex Reserves Surge to $692.9 Billion on Record FCNR Inflows
articles.excerpt: Reserves posted their biggest weekly jump in six months, buoyed by $36.7 billion in foreign currency deposits from NRIs as the RBI holds rates steady at 5.25%.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI's FCNR deposit scheme offers NRI savers competitive dollar-denominated returns with zero hedging cost, directly benefiting diaspora investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ola Electric Narrows Q1 Loss as EV Sales Rebound After Reset Year
articles.excerpt: The Bhavish Aggarwal-led company posted a net loss of ₹336 crore for the June quarter, down from ₹428 crore a year earlier, as higher scooter sales and cost cuts offset a tough commodity environment.
articles.nri_angle: Ola Electric, one of India's most closely watched EV startups, shows early signs of a turnaround after a bruising reset year that sent its stock down 75%.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Economy Sheds 23,000 Jobs in July as Hiring Stalls Unexpectedly
articles.excerpt: Nonfarm payrolls posted a surprise decline while the unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, driven by workers leaving the labor force rather than finding jobs.
articles.nri_angle: July jobs data shapes the employment outlook and Fed rate path affecting millions of workers across the U.S. economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bajaj Finance Shares Tumble 5.8% as RBI Draft Targets NBFC Revolving Credit Products
articles.excerpt: A draft RBI proposal to curb revolving-credit products offered by non-bank lenders triggered the sharpest single-day fall in Bajaj Finance shares this year.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with exposure to Indian financial stocks should monitor the RBI's evolving stance on NBFC lending practices, which could reshape the sector's growth trajectory.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SBI Q1 Profit Jumps 10% to Rs 21,121 Crore on Strong Loan Growth, Shares Rise
articles.excerpt: India's largest lender beats analyst estimates as corporate credit and retail loans power an 18.6% surge in gross advances.
articles.nri_angle: SBI's strong Q1 results reinforce the stability of India's largest bank, which serves millions of NRIs through its NRE and NRO deposit accounts.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Sugar Prices Hit Record High on Tight Supplies and Festival Demand
articles.excerpt: Wholesale prices have surged 10% in a month, with inventories heading for their lowest level in over three decades. The rally is expected to persist through November as festival season consumption peaks.
articles.image_caption: Wholesale sugar prices in India have surged to record levels amid tight domestic supplies and rising demand ahead of the festival season.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian households and diaspora families sending money home for festival preparations, the sugar price surge means higher costs for traditional sweets central to celebrations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trent Posts 22% Profit Rise as Zudio and Westside Expansion Drives Growth
articles.excerpt: The Tata Group retailer's first-quarter earnings beat estimates on the back of aggressive store rollouts into smaller Indian cities, though rising raw material costs remain a headwind.
articles.image_caption: A Zudio store in India. Trent's value fashion chain added 19 outlets during the first quarter, taking its total network to 982 stores.
articles.nri_angle: Trent's aggressive expansion and Zudio's UAE entry signal the growing strength of Indian organised retail, a sector that NRI investors have increasingly targeted.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Hits Records as Yen Intervention and Earnings Surge Reshape Markets
articles.excerpt: The Dow and S&P 500 reached all-time highs on blockbuster corporate earnings, while a rare joint U.S.-Japan intervention to support the yen exposed the fragile currency dynamics underpinning the global rally.
articles.image_caption: Wall Street indexes hit record highs as strong corporate earnings and global currency shifts reshaped market dynamics.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors with U.S. and Asian market exposure face interconnected risks as currency dynamics and AI-driven earnings reshape global markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Rally Faces Its Toughest Test as Chip Stocks Wobble and Costs Mount
articles.excerpt: A sharp selloff in semiconductor stocks and rising questions about the sustainability of AI capital spending are challenging the trade that has powered markets to record highs.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors weighing U.S. tech exposure, the tension between record AI-driven earnings and stretched valuations defines the moment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Trump Imposes 15% Tariff and Price Floors on Polysilicon to Counter China
articles.excerpt: The White House invoked a Cold War-era trade law to shield U.S. polysilicon makers from Chinese competition, setting minimum import prices across the solar and semiconductor supply chain.
articles.image_caption: The Trump administration imposed a 15% tariff and new price floors on polysilicon imports to counter China's dominance in solar supply chains.
articles.nri_angle: The tariffs highlight deepening U.S.-China competition over critical supply chains relevant to Indian-American investors and tech professionals.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SEBI Deploys AI and Rural Outreach to Combat Finfluencer Misinformation
articles.excerpt: India's market regulator is expanding investor education to panchayats and WhatsApp while its AI tool Sudarshan has already taken down 1.2 lakh misleading social media posts.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors managing Indian portfolios remotely are particularly vulnerable to finfluencer misinformation and will benefit from SEBI's enhanced digital monitoring.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Lupin Posts 16% Profit Growth in Q1 FY27 as Revenue Tops Rs 8,200 Crore
articles.excerpt: The Indian pharma major beat analyst expectations with expanding margins, though competition on key U.S. products looms over the remainder of the fiscal year.
articles.image_caption: Lupin Limited reported a 16% rise in consolidated net profit for Q1 FY27, driven by strong growth across its US and India businesses.
articles.nri_angle: Lupin is a widely held stock among NRI investors and its U.S. generics business directly serves the Indian diaspora as consumers of affordable medications.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Congo Bans Copper and Cobalt Concentrate Exports to Force Domestic Processing
articles.excerpt: The world's largest cobalt producer and a major copper source escalates its push to retain mineral wealth, sending London copper prices to near-record highs.
articles.nri_angle: India's growing EV battery and electronics industries depend on cobalt and copper supply chains that this ban could disrupt and reprice.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian IT Stocks Surge 17% in July as Global Investors Flee the AI Trade
articles.excerpt: The Nifty IT index posted its strongest month in six years as a global rotation out of AI-heavy markets turned India's lack of chip exposure into an unlikely advantage.
articles.image_caption: Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, home of the Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Indian IT stocks surged 17% in July as global investors rotated away from the AI trade.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian equity holdings saw IT stocks become the biggest winners of the global AI rotation, while those weighing India allocations gained a timely entry point.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Faces First Major Test as 911 Million Shares Unlock After Record IPO
articles.excerpt: The lockup expiry more than doubles the company's public float, creating a critical pressure point for Elon Musk's space and AI venture that has lost half its value since going public.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American tech workers and investors who hold SpaceX equity through employee grants or pre-IPO SPVs face critical decisions as the first lockup window opens.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Initiates SK Hynix Coverage With Bullish Calls, BofA Says Stock Is 'Deeply Mispriced'
articles.excerpt: Six brokerages launched coverage of the recently U.S.-listed memory chipmaker with buy ratings, citing its dominance in AI-critical high-bandwidth memory chips and a valuation gap with rival Micron.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American tech investors and semiconductor watchers should note the valuation dynamics as SK Hynix's U.S. listing opens a new avenue for exposure to the AI memory trade.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Vedanta Aluminium Seeks $1.4 Billion Bank Loan in First Major Move After Demerger
articles.excerpt: The newly independent aluminium unit is raising ₹13,500 crore from banks as Vedanta's post-split entities begin charting separate financial paths, while the parent refinances $5.2 billion in dollar debt.
articles.nri_angle: Vedanta's demerger offers NRI investors direct exposure to India's aluminium and metals growth story through pure-play listed entities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Block Raises Full-Year Profit Forecast as Cash App Growth Accelerates
articles.excerpt: Jack Dorsey's payments company beat Q2 estimates with adjusted EPS of $1.02 versus 87 cents expected, and lifted its 2026 gross profit outlook to $12.51 billion on the strength of Cash App and AI-driven cost cuts.
articles.nri_angle: Block's Cash App and Square platforms are widely used by Indian American entrepreneurs and consumers, and the company's AI-driven cost-cutting strategy mirrors trends across Silicon Valley.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sequoia Capital Raises $7 Billion for AI-Focused Expansion Under New Leadership
articles.excerpt: The Silicon Valley stalwart's first major fundraise under new co-stewards Alfred Lin and Pat Grady nearly doubles its previous expansion fund, as top VC firms collectively amass over $23 billion in four months.
articles.image_caption: Sequoia Capital has raised roughly  billion for its new AI-focused expansion fund
articles.nri_angle: Sequoia split off its India operations into Peak XV Partners in 2023; its AI-first global thesis shapes where late-stage capital flows for Indian founders building for international markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed Governor Cook Signals Readiness to Raise Rates as Inflation Risks Mount
articles.excerpt: Cook's hawkish warning joins a growing chorus at the Federal Reserve, setting up a potential clash with Chairman Warsh and the White House over the direction of interest rates.
articles.nri_angle: A potential Fed rate hike would strengthen the dollar against the rupee, pull foreign capital from Indian markets, and pressure the RBI to maintain interest rate differentials.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AI Now Drives Three in Four Finance Teams, but Data Quality Threatens to Stall the Gains
articles.excerpt: A KPMG survey of over 1,000 senior finance leaders across 20 countries found that AI adoption has more than doubled since 2024, but only 42% of organizations are prepared to audit their AI-driven financial processes.
articles.image_caption: A growing majority of finance teams now use AI tools, though data quality remains a key challenge
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin finance and technology professionals leading AI deployment at global institutions face a pivotal shift from adoption speed to governance maturity as the determining factor for AI-driven performance.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: PB Fintech Profit Jumps 92% as Policybazaar's Insurance Engine Fires on All Cylinders
articles.excerpt: The Policybazaar parent reported operating revenues of Rs 1,888 crore for Q1 FY27, with EBITDA expanding fourfold as margin gains accelerated across the insurance platform.
articles.nri_angle: PB Fintech's strong results highlight opportunities for NRI investors in India's fast-growing online insurance market, where penetration remains well below developed-market levels.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Holds Rates Steady, Raises India's GDP Growth Forecast to 6.7% Amid Oil and Inflation Risks
articles.excerpt: The central bank's fourth consecutive pause at 5.25% comes with a modest growth upgrade and lower inflation projections, but economists remain divided on how long the hold can last.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India held its key lending rate steady while raising India's GDP growth forecast to 6.7 percent.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors, stable rates support near-term asset prices but a potential oil-driven tightening cycle could pressure bond yields, equity valuations, and the rupee.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: U.S. Mortgage Rates Hit Highest Level in Over a Year as Iran Conflict Keeps Inflation Elevated
articles.excerpt: The 30-year fixed rate reached 6.66%, driving pending home sales to a three-month low, but falling asking prices offer an opening for buyers willing to negotiate.
articles.image_caption: U.S. mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level in over a year as inflation concerns persist
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans are among the most active homebuyer demographics in the U.S., and higher rates disproportionately affect first-time H-1B professional buyers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Chairman Rajiv Kumar Pledges Zero Tolerance at AGM as Governance Reset Takes Shape
articles.excerpt: Former finance secretary tells shareholders the board will enforce accountability, while management projects CASA and NIM improvement as legacy HDFC Ltd borrowings mature.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is one of the most widely held Indian equities among NRI investors, and the stock decline in 2026 has eroded significant portfolio value for overseas shareholders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Michael Burry Warns of 1987-Style Crash as S&P 500 Hits Fresh Record
articles.excerpt: The Big Short investor maintains bearish bets against semiconductor stocks and compares the AI-driven rally to the final months of the dot-com bubble, even as the market climbs to new highs.
articles.nri_angle: Indian investors with significant exposure to US tech stocks and semiconductor ETFs through platforms like Vested and INDmoney face direct portfolio risk if Burry's thesis on overvalued AI plays proves correct.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Approves First Polymer Banknote Trials for ₹10 and ₹20 Notes
articles.excerpt: The government greenlights RBI field trials of one billion plastic notes each in two denominations, reviving a decade-old plan to make low-value currency more durable and harder to counterfeit.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs who regularly handle rupee cash during visits home will encounter more durable, cleaner notes in lower denominations — and the polymer shift mirrors currency modernization already underway in the UK, Canada, and Australia.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Banks Near $15 Billion Loan for Anthropic Data Center Backed by Google Guarantees
articles.excerpt: Morgan Stanley leads a bank consortium financing a massive Texas AI campus, with Google backstopping the deal in exchange for a 20% equity stake.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American engineers hold senior positions at both Anthropic and Google's AI hardware division, and the deal will accelerate demand for AI talent in the U.S.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
